intro.title: Quick app tour
intro.text: In about half a minute I'll show what everything here is for — tab by tab. Tap “Start tutorial”, or skip it if you already know your way around.

tabs.title: Three app sections
tabs.text: Everything is split into three tabs: “Budget” — settings and transactions, “Overview” — status and forecast, “Insights” — stats and analytics. Switch here anytime.

viewToggle.title: By days or 12 months
viewToggle.text: “By days” is the detailed plan for the current month. “12 months” shows every month at once. This toggle works in every section.

currency.title: 3 starting currencies
currency.text: Pick the three currencies you track (e.g. UAH, USD, EUR). Each currency can be chosen only once — all bookkeeping runs in them.

balances.title: Starting balances
balances.text: Enter how much money you start with in each currency. Every day's balance is calculated from these amounts.

region.title: Region for local rate
region.text: Choose a country (or “auto detect”) so your local currency is pulled in as well whenever rates are refreshed.

autoFetch.title: Auto rates mode
autoFetch.text: Turn this on so you don't have to click — NBU rates are fetched automatically once a day when you open the page.

updateRates.title: Update rates
updateRates.text: This button instantly pulls the latest currency rates from the NBU. You can also type rates in manually above.

localInteraction.title: Local interaction
localInteraction.text: Save your whole budget to a JSON file on disk and import it back when needed — handy for backups and moving between devices.

budgetStatus.title: Budget status
budgetStatus.text: Your current balance, total value in the chosen currency and the forecast for any day or the end of the month are always shown here.

daysTable.title: Days & transactions
daysTable.text: Add income and expenses to specific days of the month. The table auto-calculates the day balance and the running total. On phones days are shown as cards.

months.title: 12-month overview
months.text: Each month is stored separately with its own transactions. Tap a month to open it day by day, and use “Add transaction” to add entries across different days of several months at once.

overview.title: The “Overview” tab
overview.text: A quick read of the month: net cash flow, daily budget left, projected balance, largest expense and savings rate — all in one place.

statistics.title: Detailed statistics
statistics.text: Income, expenses and the difference per currency and in total — so you see the results without doing the math yourself.

analytics.title: Analytics & insights
analytics.text: Top expenses, breakdown by category and week, savings streak and forecasts. That's it — you're all set to start entering your budget!

infoTips.settings: Configure currencies, opening balances, exchange rates, import/export, and quick transaction actions.
infoTips.currency: Pick exactly 3 currencies to track. Each can be chosen only once — balances and transactions use these.
infoTips.balances: Opening amounts for the start of the month. Daily balances build from these. “Month budget” shows the running total with transactions.
infoTips.exchangeRates: Rates between your budget currencies. Buy / sell are used when converting totals into the display currency.
infoTips.region: Country for a local currency during NBU rate refresh (in addition to your three selected currencies).
infoTips.autoFetch: When enabled, NBU rates refresh automatically on page open (once per day).
infoTips.localInteraction: Save the whole budget as a JSON file on disk, or import a backup later.
infoTips.security: End-to-end encryption: the password stays only with you and is never sent to the server.
infoTips.deleteAccount: Permanently deletes your account and all cloud data. A local JSON file on disk is not touched.
infoTips.clearDays: Clears day transactions and descriptions (opening balances and settings stay).
infoTips.addTransaction: Add income or expense on selected days of the current month (or across months in “12 months” mode).
infoTips.forecast: Copy recurring transactions from existing months into chosen future months — handy for regular payments.
infoTips.csvImport: Import a bank statement (Monobank and other CSVs with date / description / amount) into the current budget month.
infoTips.budgetMonth: The month you are working in. CSV import takes the date from the file. Storage limit is 12 months.
infoTips.budgetStatus: Current balances per currency and total value in the display currency. The slider shows a forecast for a chosen day or month.
infoTips.totalValue: All currency balances converted into the selected display currency using your rates.
infoTips.selectDay: The slider shows the cumulative balance on any day of the month (including all transactions up to that day).
infoTips.selectMonth: The slider shows the rolling projected balance at the end of the chosen month in the 12-month window.
infoTips.criticalDays: Days with the lowest projected balance this month — where the balance dips the most.
infoTips.criticalMonths: Months in the 12-month window with the lowest rolling projected balance.
infoTips.statistics: Income and expense totals for the period in the display currency and per currency.
infoTips.analytics: Average spend, balance forecast, no-spend days, savings rate, and category / week / month breakdowns.
infoTips.avgDailyExpense: Average daily spending for the period (all expenses ÷ number of days).
infoTips.projectedBalance: Expected balance at month end / end of the 12-month window based on pace and planned transactions.
infoTips.noSpendDays: How many days in the period had no expenses.
infoTips.savingsRate: Share of income left after expenses: (income − expenses) / income.
infoTips.spendingVsIncome: How much of income was spent this period (100% = expenses equal income).
infoTips.topExpenses: Largest individual expenses in the period, in the display currency.
infoTips.byCategory: Expense split by category. You can filter to one category.
infoTips.weeklyBreakdown: Spending by week of the month, or by month in 12-month mode.
infoTips.overview: Quick snapshot: period progress, net cash flow, daily budget left, and end-balance forecast.
infoTips.transactionExplorer: Search and filter all transactions in the month by type, currency, day, and description.
infoTips.multiMonthExplorer: Search transactions across every month in the 12-month window.
infoTips.twelveMonthOverview: Month cards with income, expenses, and closing balance. Tap a month to open the day-by-day view.
infoTips.monthlyPlanner: Plan future income and expenses by month, separate from actual budget transactions — for forecasting.
infoTips.budgetView: “By days” — detailed plan for the current month. “12 months” — overview and actions across the month window.
infoTips.budgetBook: A separate budget book with its own months and settings. You can have up to 2 books (e.g. personal and family).
infoTips.forecastMonths: Months that already have the same transaction (type, currency, description, and day) will not get a duplicate.
infoTips.forecastRecurring: Same type, currency, description, and day across months — selected by default. Same name on different days are separate items.
infoTips.forecastUnique: All other transactions from every month (including the same name on different days) — not selected by default.
infoTips.multiMonthMonths: The transaction is added to each chosen month on the selected days. If a month has fewer days (e.g. 31), it lands on the last day.
infoTips.multiMonthDays: Day numbers 1–31. In shorter months the day shifts to the month’s last day.
infoTips.plannerMultiMonth: The same planned transaction can be added to several months in the window at once.
